## TXO VIX-style term structure

This project downloads Taiwan Futures Exchange TXO option quotes, estimates a VIX-style variance for each expiration, and publishes a daily static term-structure chart.

<div class="project-card">
  <p id="vix-status">Loading the latest VIX-style chart…</p>
  <img id="vix-chart" alt="Latest TXO VIX-style implied-volatility term structure" style="width:100%; max-width:960px;">
</div>

## TAIEX Futures (TX) IV calibration

The chart inverts Black-76 implied volatility from OTM TXO settlement prices. Only TX futures with exactly the same expiration date are accepted.

<div class="project-card">
  <p id="tx-status">Loading the latest TX calibration chart…</p>
  <img id="tx-chart" alt="Latest TXO implied-volatility calibration using same-expiry TX futures" style="width:100%; max-width:1100px;">
</div>

## Mini-TAIEX Futures (MTX) IV calibration

The chart uses MTX futures independently from TX. Only MTX contracts whose expiration date exactly matches the TXO expiration are accepted.

<div class="project-card">
  <p id="mtx-status">Loading the latest MTX calibration chart…</p>
  <img id="mtx-chart" alt="Latest TXO implied-volatility calibration using same-expiry MTX futures" style="width:100%; max-width:1100px;">
</div>

<p>
  <a href="https://github.com/siang-dai/txo-vix-term-structure">Source code, data rules, and methodology</a>
</p>

<script>
(() => {
  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "txo-vix-term-structure";
  const stamp = Date.now();
  const rawBase = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main/output`;

  const setChart = (imageId, statusId, filename) => {
    const image = document.getElementById(imageId);
    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    image.src = `${rawBase}/${filename}?t=${stamp}`;
    image.onerror = () => {
      status.textContent = "The chart is not available yet. Run the repository workflow once.";
    };
  };

  setChart("vix-chart", "vix-status", "latest_term_structure.png");
  setChart("tx-chart", "tx-status", "latest_tx_iv_calibration.png");
  setChart("mtx-chart", "mtx-status", "latest_mtx_iv_calibration.png");

  fetch(`${rawBase}/latest.json?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("VIX metadata unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(meta => {
      document.getElementById("vix-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} · Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      document.getElementById("vix-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated VIX-style chart.";
    });

  fetch(`${rawBase}/latest_iv.json?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("IV metadata unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(meta => {
      const tx = meta.products.TX;
      const mtx = meta.products.MTX;
      document.getElementById("tx-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} · ${tx.matched_expirations} matched expirations · ${tx.plotted_points} OTM IV points · Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
      document.getElementById("mtx-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} · ${mtx.matched_expirations} matched expirations · ${mtx.plotted_points} OTM IV points · Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      document.getElementById("tx-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated TX IV calibration chart.";
      document.getElementById("mtx-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated MTX IV calibration chart.";
    });
})();
</script>

## Method note

“IV calibration” here means numerical inversion of the Black-76 formula for each eligible OTM option quote. It is not a parametric volatility-surface model fit. The workflow uses settlement prices, requires exact option–futures expiration matching, and performs no nearest-contract substitution or IV smoothing.

## Reproducibility

The code repository contains the downloader, cleaning rules, VIX-style calculation, Black-76 inversion, tests, generated CSV files, and daily charts. GitHub Actions refreshes the outputs on weekdays.
